installSteps.text: Install StarCraft first if you have not already — ShieldBattery Client is an add-on and needs the base game.

The quickest route is the PlayBound Launcher: open StarCraft, find ShieldBattery Client in its mods list and press Install. The launcher downloads the official release and places it in the right folder for you.
To install it by hand, download the latest release archive from github.com/ShieldBattery/ShieldBattery/releases.
Extract the archive into the "ShieldBattery" folder inside your StarCraft installation directory.
Start StarCraft and enable ShieldBattery Client from the in-game mods or add-ons menu. The download is roughly 110 MB.
Install StarCraft: Remastered from Battle.net first. ShieldBattery runs the real StarCraft client; it does not replace it.
Download the ShieldBattery installer from shieldbattery.net/download and run it. PlayBound opens that page for you when you press Install.
Sign in to ShieldBattery and point it at your StarCraft folder if it does not find it on its own. Matchmaking, lobbies and replays all run through its client.
Install StarCraft first if you have not already — Cosmonarchy BW is an add-on and needs the base game.

The quickest route is the PlayBound Launcher: open StarCraft, find Cosmonarchy BW in its mods list and press Install. The launcher downloads the official release and places it in the right folder for you.
To install it by hand, download the latest release archive from github.com/MicroGamer/CosmonarchyBW/releases.
Extract the archive into the "Cosmonarchy" folder inside your StarCraft installation directory.
Start StarCraft and enable Cosmonarchy BW from the in-game mods or add-ons menu. The download is roughly 350 MB.
Download Fraud Launcher 2 from the Cosmonarchy setup page and extract it. PlayBound opens that page for you when you press Install.
Choose where to install and which Cosmonarchy game build to play. The launcher installs StarCraft 1.16 and Cosmonarchy together, so it does not use your Battle.net copy of StarCraft.
Press Play. The first run downloads 3–5 GB, depending on whether you install one game build or both.
